content:
With most WhatsApp users on iOS now officially receiving the Liquid Glass redesign, the messaging app is testing another visual change—this time focused on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

The new chat bubbles look a bit more rounded

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted hints in the app's code of a redesign for WhatsApp chat bubbles. Now, the site reports that the new bubbles have started rolling out to some users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's the report from WABetaInfo:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders that surrounded them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more cohesive.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is already available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. It's still unknown when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users.
